Name: More Backpack Upgrades
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13826/] Custom Backpack Framework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to add three extra backpack upgrades to the store. Upgrades are now:

[list]
[*]Large Backpack - 24 slots, 2,000g
[*]Deluxe Backpack - 36 slots, 10,000g
[*]Super Backpack - 48 slots, 50,000g
[*]Superduper Backpack - 60 slots, 250,000g
[*]Supercalifragalistic Backpack - 72 slots, 1,000,000g
[/list]
[youtube]ndK12DSSdro[/youtube]

You can change every part of this mod by editing the [b]content.json[/b] file.


This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13826/]Custom Backpack Framework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
